mentions.name: Kinkoda
mentions.description: A bootstrapped cooperative building tooling and running experiments to make Sociocracy viable as a governance approach. It takes no VC or external investment and is considering coop bonds as a capital-raising mechanism.
mentions.problem: Sociocracy is not yet viable in practice, which the project's tooling and experimentation aim to change.
mentions.source_excerpt: Coop I'm trying to bootstrap. Interested in building tooling and experimenting to make Sociocracy viable. No VC, No external investment, other than mulling Coop bonds for capital raising capability. https://kinkoda.com
